summary.text: Amaad Rivera-Wagner is a Democratic member of the Wisconsin State Assembly who has represented District 90 since January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026, general election.
He previously served as chief of staff to Green Bay Mayor Eric Genrich.

paragraphs.text: Amaad Rivera-Wagner's career experience includes working as chief of staff to Green Bay Mayor Eric Genrich, as a housing policy director, and as a policy advisor to U.S. Sen. Ed Markey (D).
He has served as co-chair of the Diversity and Inclusion task force for the Green Bay Chamber and as the founding co-chair of the Advocacy Council for the United Way of Brown County.
Rivera-Wagner took office on January 6, 2025, succeeding Democrat Kristina Shelton in District 90, and serves on the Consumer Protection and Local Government committees.
